title: CRM Hygiene
searchIntent: grok bot to keep my crm up to date
intro: Nobody updates the CRM, which is why every sales team has a stale one and why this is such an obvious job to hand over. The work is mechanical and unloved: filling fields after a call, merging duplicates, flagging deals that have not moved, keeping the pipeline reflecting reality rather than optimism. A bot doing it badly is still better than the status quo of it not being done, which is a lower bar than most jobs on this site and worth saying plainly. Supply is limited so far — this is a job that needs a connection to whatever system you actually use, and the public templates skew towards the two or three most common ones. If yours is not among them, expect to do integration work rather than install a template, and weigh that against how much stale data is really costing you.
wouldNeed: Write to the CRM you actually run, rather than to the two or three the public templates were built against.
Fill fields from the call it just sat in, not by restating what the deal record already says.
Merge duplicates without discarding the history attached to either side of the merge.
Tell a deal that has gone quiet apart from one that is dead, and be willing to say the second out loud.
Leave a trail of what it changed and why. A field filled in wrongly and silently is worse than a field left blank.
